parsed.summary: The PR changes ForeignKey validation to use the base manager instead of the default manager. This addresses the issue of validating archived articles in forms.

issues.description: This change may introduce behavioral regression risks for existing applications that rely on the default manager for validation. It could lead to unexpected validation failures if the base manager includes records that the default manager excludes.
The PR does not include any new tests to verify the behavior of ForeignKey validation with the base manager. This increases the risk of regressions in the future.
